description: This file defines the JSON schema for the RemoteActionMapping API, including methods, events, data structures, and metadata related to remote controller actions and mappings. It serves as an interface definition for the plugin controlling remote mappings.

methods.name: cancelCodeDownload
methods.description: Cancels downloading IR and five digit codes from the IRRF database.

methods.name: clearKeyActionMapping
methods.description: Clears an action mapping for the specified keys.

methods.name: getFullKeyActionMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping of all action keys.

methods.name: getKeymap
methods.description: Returns a hard-coded list of key names.

methods.name: getLastUsedDeviceID
methods.description: Returns the last used remote information.

methods.name: getSingleKeyActionMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping for a single action key.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCode
methods.description: Sets the TV and AVR five digit code.

methods.name: setKeyActionMapping
methods.description: Sets the mapping of a single action key. This method is unavailable (returns error) if the remote supports 5 digit codes.
